text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience building practical, business-focused AI and Python solutions. I’d be glad to help you shape the right strategy for your website and YouTube channel before you start publishing content, so you can build with a clear plan instead of guessing your way forward.

For your tourism, sightseeing, and black car service brand, I’d focus on helping you define the best approach across SEO, keyword selection, content direction, and overall marketing strategy. Since your goal is to promote both a city and a business, the right content structure matters a lot: the topics, search intent, page organization, and YouTube positioning all need to support visibility and conversions. I can help you think through those decisions from a business-oriented perspective so the content is built to attract the right audience and support your goals.

My background includes extensive experience with Python, machine learning, NLP, and modern AI tooling such as LangChain, OpenAI API, and Hugging Face Transformers. While this project is not a coding-heavy machine learning build, that experience helps me approach strategy in a structured, analytical way.

A couple of relevant past projects:
- Card fraud scoring API: built a service that reads card events from Kafka and returns a fraud score before authorization. It achieved p95 latency of 38 ms and helped reduce fraud losses by 22% during the pilot.
- Invoice field extraction: built a service that reads scanned supplier invoices and returns vendor, dates, totals, and line items as JSON. It reached 96.2% field-level accuracy on 1,800 test invoices and cut manual data entry by about 70%.

I’d be happy to bring that same practical, results-oriented mindset to your website and YouTube planning. If helpful, I can work with you on keyword strategy, content themes, SEO direction, Google Adsense considerations, and how to position the channel to support your local business goals.
